properties.description: At least five distinct failed RBAC assignment/role definition writes by one caller in one resource group and fixed ten-minute bin. These are operational failures, not necessarily authorization denials or an attack. Disabled lab definition; no incident creation or automation.
properties.query:
AzureActivity
| where TimeGenerated between (ago(1h) .. now())
| where OperationNameValue in~ ("Microsoft.Authorization/roleAssignments/write", "Microsoft.Authorization/roleDefinitions/write")
| where ActivityStatusValue in~ ("Failed", "Failure")
| where isnotempty(EventDataId)
| extend TargetResourceId = coalesce(ResourceId, _ResourceId)
| extend SourceIPAddress = iff(CallerIpAddress !contains "/" and isnotempty(parse_ipv6(CallerIpAddress)), CallerIpAddress, "")
| project TimeGenerated, OperationNameValue, ActivityStatusValue, Caller, SourceIPAddress, TargetResourceId, ResourceGroup, CorrelationId, EventDataId
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by EventDataId
| where isnotempty(Caller) and isnotempty(ResourceGroup)
| extend CallerKey = tolower(Caller), ScopeKey = tolower(ResourceGroup)
| summarize FailureCount=count(), FirstSeen=min(TimeGenerated), TimeGenerated=max(TimeGenerated), EventIds=make_set(EventDataId, 100), Operations=make_set(OperationNameValue, 10) by CallerKey, ScopeKey, WindowStart=bin(TimeGenerated, 10m)
| where FailureCount >= 5
| project TimeGenerated, FirstSeen, Caller=CallerKey, ResourceGroup=ScopeKey, FailureCount, WindowStart, EventIds, Operations
